checks.text: With no components the page shows the heading "Grade Calculator", the text "No components yet", and the summary line "Weighted Grade: 0.00%".

Filling the field labelled "Component Name" with "Midterm", the field labelled "Score" with "85", and the field labelled "Weight" with "40", then clicking the button "Add component" adds a table row that contains "Midterm", "85.00", "40%", and "34.00"; the summary shows "Weighted Grade: 34.00%" and "No components yet" is gone.
After also adding a component with Name "Final Exam", Score "92", and Weight "60", a table row contains "Final Exam", "92.00", "60%", and "55.20", and the summary shows "Weighted Grade: 89.20%".

Clicking "Add component" with an empty Component Name, or with a Score that is empty, negative, or greater than 100, adds no table row and shows the message "Enter a name and a score between 0 and 100".

Every table row has a button named "Delete <name>". With the components Midterm (85, 40) and Final Exam (92, 60), clicking "Delete Final Exam" removes that row and the summary shows "Weighted Grade: 34.00%".

When the sum of weights is not 100, the app still computes the weighted average based on the provided weights: adding only a component with Name "Quiz", Score "100", and Weight "10" shows "Weighted Grade: 10.00%" and a warning text "Weights sum to 10%".
Typing "abc" in the field labelled "Score" and pressing Tab shows the message "Score must be a number" and adds no table row.
With components Midterm (85, 40) and Final Exam (92, 60), the breakdown table shows a total row with the text "Total" and "100%" in the weight column.
Reload keeps the component list: after adding Midterm (85, 40) and reloading the page, the table still shows a row with "Midterm", "85.00", "40%", and the summary line "Weighted Grade: 34.00%".
